claim_ceiling: Operational evidence for one local supervised staging rehearsal on one WSL host. This is not production evidence, production readiness, external availability, certification, release approval, or governance admission.

diagnostics.observation: The predecessor HTTPS live campaign passed 6/10 and then recreated Keycloak without the durable MFA overlay during repeat setup. The durable overlay was restored and verified before target-specific controls ran.
A detached predecessor app process reached health 200 but did not survive shell cleanup. The supervised systemd deployment is the accepted runtime target.

open_questions: Run the same sealed exact envelope in a remotely isolated staging environment with production-shaped ingress, managed secrets, monitoring, retention, backup storage, and independent availability boundaries.
Define the production admission owner and minimum soak/load/error-budget denominator.
